acceptance: Old clone, API and release-download URLs redirect to joeharris76/tractable; `git ls-remote` succeeds through both URLs.
The `pypi` environment and branch protections survive the rename.
The local checkout lives at ~/Developer/tractable; `git worktree list` shows no broken entries.
Codex starts its tracker server from the installed todo-db-mcp and lists tools.
Undo documented and still possible: `gh repo rename todo-db`.
context:
Guardrails (ADR 0013): no state-schema change, data migration, or trailer change; the 1.0.0 release is the rename only; each project switches runtime, config dir, MCP registration, skill mirrors and scripts in one change; the old todo-db tool stays installed until decommission; never create a repository named joeharris76/todo-db; historical records (CHANGELOG entries, earlier ADRs, consumer evidence, exports) are not rewritten. Existing tracker configs keep the old remote URL until Phase 2; GitHub redirects keep them working.

2026-11-06: Done. `gh repo rename tractable`: repository is joeharris76/tractable (public, default branch main, environment pypi kept; no branch protection or rulesets existed before or after). Redirects verified: `gh api repos/joeharris76/todo-db` returns joeharris76/tractable; `git ls-remote` through the old and new URLs returns the same main (b4389b7) and todo-state (53dcc6b); the old release URL .../todo-db/releases/download/v0.15.0/SHA256SUMS returns 200. Removed six clean worktrees whose commits are on main (todo-db-not-before, wt-batch-source-receipt, wt-batch-v2, wt-prepared-work-contract, wt-release-0.7.2, wt-sync-batch-loop) and their merged local branches; remote branches untouched. origin now https://github.com/joeharris76/tractable.git; main fast-forwarded to b4389b7. Checkout moved to ~/Developer/tractable with a temporary symlink ~/Developer/todo-db -> tractable so live sessions whose paths name the old folder keep working (remove in tractable-p7-decommission-todo-db). Unmerged worktrees moved with `git worktree move` to ~/Developer/tractable.wt-{legacy-id-migration,release-version-docs,session-state-fields}; `git worktree repair` run, including the jcode scratch worktree. Codex: [mcp_servers.todo-db] now runs /Users/joe/.local/bin/todo-db-mcp (0.15.0) instead of `uv run --project ~/Developer/todo-db`; the new path is trusted. A fresh server from ~/Developer/tractable initialised as todo-db 0.15.0 with 22 tools, bound to the old remote URL via discovery. Tracker writes still use the redirected old URL until Phase 2 moves the config. Undo: `gh repo rename todo-db --repo joeharris76/tractable`.
description: Phase 1. Run `gh repo rename tractable` on joeharris76/todo-db; set `origin` to https://github.com/joeharris76/tractable.git in the main checkout and every worktree; remove stale worktrees whose work is merged or abandoned; rename ~/Developer/todo-db to ~/Developer/tractable and run `git worktree repair`. In the same sitting, repoint the Codex registration (~/.codex/config.toml `[mcp_servers.todo-db]`) from `uv run --project ~/Developer/todo-db` to the installed `todo-db-mcp`, so it never points at a missing path; Phase 5 later switches it to tractable-mcp. Decision gate: owner go-ahead for this first externally visible step; no open PR other than ones intended to survive the rename; no batch in progress on this tracker.
